claim_ceiling: Exploratory mixed-real-film artistic appearance on consumed development inputs; not stock calibration, causal attribution, independent validation or guaranteed preservation.
feature_license: Pinned local model card declares Apache-2.0; frozen pretrained representation, no segmentation head.
rationale: Hinge adversarial term has unit weight; existing renderer bounds and conservative edge/shadow/coefficient/spatial penalties are retained from the prior full-color operator, not fitted to new output. Modest R1 and spectral normalization regularize the critic. Four identical 1200-step budgets test this one choice, not convergence in general.
sampling: Exactly equal collection counts across schedule. Within collection choose uniformly a cluster having source and reference support, then uniformly an eligible image, then uniformly one valid patch in that image/cluster. Real and fake cluster IDs are identical per pair. Log actual image exposures and empty cluster support; do not modify K or thresholds to force support.
features: Film references explicitly honor EXIF display orientation before ICC-to-sRGB8 conversion (Italy10 has orientation8); digital/challenge assets are already upright normalized sRGB. Same sRGB8 precision and aspect-preserving 224 preview for all domains. DINO receives repeated encoded grayscale, neutral 0.5 padding and ImageNet normalization; no contrast normalization or center crop. Fully valid stride-14 tokens alone enter global mean and cluster candidates. Local sampling clamps to fully valid token centers. Global transformer attention can still see neutral padding.
critic_input: 64x64 fully valid RGB patch; fixed separable binomial 5x5 low-pass then 4x area reduction to16x16 for both real and fake. This suppresses high-frequency codec/grain differences, not all acquisition confounds.
decision: Inspect blinded contact panels and native local/mean-field outputs against original; keep frozen alias mapping separate until qualitative notes. An arm advances only with worthwhile rich comfortable appearance on all four inputs for BOTH seeds and no consequential new face/object/text/detail defect. Seed disagreement is inconclusive; no best-seed choice. Conditioning/locality claims also require a coherent benefit over the corresponding controls. No automatic metric promotion or strength/loss/reference rescue.
